title: airtight jars with wooden spoons
text: airtight jars with wooden spoons. I purchased 2 sets to give as gifts with the old 70's fav, friendship tea in it.  They are the perfect size and the wooden spoon does the perfect '2 scoops' to make the perfect cup of tea.  They were very well packaged and are beautiful with the tea in them.  Highly recommend if you need a similar jar. They are clear glass.  The spoons are wooden.  There is a collar on the lid - sort of airtight, mostly.  I would buy again.
